scope: Draft integration diagnostics before source freeze, not acceptance evidence

findings.recovery: Use original business_fail outcome; subsequent smoke reaches cycle2/P07/RUNNING with manual evidence in cycle1 history.

findings.finding: First build rejected importing sqe-profile.mjs without declaration (TS7016/TS7006).
findings.recovery: Added literal readonly sqe-profile.d.mts; subsequent TypeScript/Vite build passed52modules.

findings.finding: TC inventory found unplanned extra waiting/collected/reported/judged checkpoints on several new scenarios.
findings.recovery: Removed only unplanned checkpoint marks; retained actual protocol events and approved literal checkpoint lists.

findings.classification: TC oracle clarification before browser acceptance
findings.finding: Current cycle2 SQE records reset after FAIL; P23 reported-two checkpoint is report accepted while P23 RUNNING, before step success. Task IDs are in selected detail; prior attempt references are in history.
findings.recovery: TC keeps current/history assertions distinct and literal planned boundaries; no product past-proof promotion.

findings.classification: independent source review defect before freeze
findings.finding: Unconditional empty P24 SQE detail could appear on exempt or unrelated P24, despite no SQE execution.
findings.recovery: Require snapshot SQE association for empty/fresh P24 detail; historical records require their own proof. Reviewer reapproved and TC adds exemption/pending retry regression.

findings.classification: actual UI history readability defect found by browser geometry
findings.finding: Long archived SQE result703px was clipped by existing200px history overflow container; full viewport bbox alone did not make text readable. Four-by-four hit test rejected clipped target.
findings.recovery: Add view-only history expand/collapse with accessible state and scenario-change reset; retain default compact history. TC expands before history geometry/capture and checks reset. No inspection criterion weakened.

findings.classification: TC history reset expectation before final gate
findings.finding: A diagnostic asserted an expand button immediately after changing to cursor0, where history and its control are correctly absent.
findings.recovery: Assert no control at cursor0 and compact aria-expanded=false at the first checkpoint with history; rerun standalone16/16 andhost17/17 passed.

evidence_limit: Early diagnostic terminal outputs were inspected but no separate full raw command logs retained. This summary does not substitute for frozen unit/build/browser/gate proof.
acceptance: Final frozen candidate passed259 units and11 commands after TC geometry correction; see sqe-ui-review.json. Prior automated pass rejected by image review is preserved separately.
